question: Indian shooter Singhraj Adhana won the bronze medal in the men's ________ air pistol SH1 class at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10 m.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian shooter Singhraj Adhana won the bronze medal in the **men's 10 m air pistol SH1** class at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.
 
• He belongs to Faridabad in Haryana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• Singhraj Adhana took home silver in the mixed 50 metre pistol event at the Tokyo Paralympics on 4 September 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indian contingent finished their campaign at the Tokyo Paralympic Games 2020 on 5 September 2021 at an all-time high by securing a total of 19 medals.__
 
• It includes 5 gold, 8 silver, and 6 bronze medals.
 
• Out of a total of 162 nations, India has finished 24th in the overall medal tally, while its accomplishment of 19 medals is ranked 20th based on the number of medals.​
